## Episode Thesis

This is a Pengepodden episode recorded at Nordnet Live, with Øystein Kalleklev (Eastern Pacific Shipping) and Nadia Viggen (Svelland Capital) discussing a historically long shipping upcycle and an oil market disrupted by the closed Strait of Hormuz. Tankers, LPG and car carriers earn exceptional rates on longer routes and inefficient trade, while LNG shipping is at rock bottom because Qatar has shut its production. Kalleklev warns that the cycle is overdue and order books are swelling, so shipowners should pay out super-profits as dividends and lock in contract backlog rather than order ships speculatively. Viggen highlights algorithm-driven oil volatility, tight diesel and naphtha supply, very low Chinese product inventories and the risk of a European energy crisis if the winter is cold.
